title: GridPermit Locality Record
description: Master schema for every structured California residential solar/battery/permitting data record. One record = one (city, utility) pair. Produced by agents/data-collector.md. Every future page, calculator, and content-generation tool must read data through this schema, not invent its own shape. See docs/DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md.

record_id.description: Naming rule: <state-code>-<county-slug>-<city-slug>-<utility-slug>, lowercase kebab-case only, no underscores. Must exactly match the record's filename (minus .json) under data/localities/. Note: this pattern cannot mechanically distinguish where one segment ends and the next begins when county/city names are themselves multi-word (e.g. 'santa-clara', 'san-jose') — segment boundaries are a documentation convention (see docs/DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md), not something this regex enforces beyond overall shape.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was produced against. 1.3.0 added value_usd_per_watt as a new optional field on programItem (battery_programs/rebates items) — additive only, not added to programItem's required list, so no existing record needed migration to remain schema-valid (all four existing records were migrated anyway, for consistency, per docs/DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md). 1.2.0 added generation_supplier and eligibility_constraints as new required fields, extended battery_programs/rebates items with effective_from/expires_on/status, and replaced required_documents' plain-string items with structured {name, required_when, source_ids} objects. 1.1.0 tightened record_id to lowercase kebab-case, no underscores. Bump on further changes; see docs/DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md for the migration rule.

last_verified.description: Record-level: date this record was last researched/verified. Null only for a record that has never been run.

sources.description: Shared citation registry for this record. Every source_ids entry anywhere in this record must resolve to an id in this array.

confidenceScore.description: 0 = unknown/unverified. 1 = directly confirmed on a Tier-1 official source within 90 days. See agents/data-collector.md for the full scale.

sourceIds.description: References into this record's top-level `sources[].id`. Must be empty when confidence is 0 / value is null.

else.description: value is non-null: enforces the agent rule 'every non-null field must have a source'.

value_usd_per_watt.description: Dollars per Watt of installed capacity, e.g. a per-watt solar rebate ($0.60/W). Distinct unit from value_usd_per_kwh (battery capacity) and value_usd_flat — do not convert between them. Null if not applicable to this item.

effective_from.description: ISO date this program/tier's terms took effect, if stated by a source. Null if unknown.

expires_on.description: ISO date this program/tier's terms end, if stated by a source. Null if unknown or open-ended.

status.description: 'active'/'expired' only when a source directly supports it (e.g. an explicit expires_on date has passed, or a source states current status). Otherwise 'unknown' — never inferred from silence.

required_when.description: Condition under which this document is required (e.g. 'always', 'commercial/multifamily only'). Null if not specified by the source.

type.description: 'cca' = Community Choice Aggregation (e.g. Ava Community Energy/EBCE), 'utility' = the same entity as the record's `utility` field generates by default, 'other' = neither (e.g. direct access).

property_types.description: Property types this rule set applies to, e.g. ['single-family', 'duplex']. Empty array if not specified/limited by the source.

system_size_kw_ac_max.description: Max system AC capacity in kW for this rule set to apply, if stated. Null if unstated.

system_size_kw_dc_max.description: Max system DC capacity in kW for this rule set to apply, if stated. Null if unstated.

thermal_capacity_kw_max.description: Max thermal capacity in kW for this rule set to apply (solar thermal/water heating), if stated. Null if unstated.

program_or_pathway.description: Name of the expedited program/permitting pathway this rule set belongs to, e.g. 'Instant Solar Permit (ISP) / SolarAPP+'. Null if not a named pathway.

other_conditions.description: Any other stated conditions not captured by the structured fields above. Empty array if none.
